turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have eighteen minutes before a call, Hale. Why was my son's mark changed to a zero, and why did I find out from Owen instead of from you?
Sorry, I'm a bit frazzled, it's report card week.
Report card week isn't Owen's problem. He saw a zero on his phone in the middle of class. Who decided on it, and did anyone speak to him first?
You're the first parent this month who's actually listened to me. Thank you. I mean it.
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked who decided on the zero, and you haven't answered.
I really needed that today. Can we just be kind to each other in here?
Kind was a phone call before the gradebook, Hale. I have sixteen minutes. Who entered the zero, and on what basis?
